boundary.description: From the junction of the Hyndburn, Rossendale and Burnley District Boundaries at Higher Moor, (to the E of Accrington) E by the Rossendale - Burnley District boundary to the inflow into Clowbridge Reservoir at Limy Water, SE by the Rossendale - Burnley District boundary to the E side of Clough Bottom Reservoir, S by a straight line to Newchurch Old Road at its junction with the footpath then by a line drawn between the Fernhill estate (Rawtenstall and Newchurch parish) and the Rockcliffe Estate (Bacup and Whitworth parish) to the steps on Anvil Street, W along Anvil Street, Rushton St, crossing Newchurch Road, Glen Street and Lee Road to the SE corner of the cemetery, S by a straight line to the civil parish boundary stone at Jackson's Moor. S to the boundary stone at Old Slink Slack and W by the Rossendale - Rochdale District boundary to and along the track (Rossendale Way) passing S of Cowpe Lowe to the end of Sand Beds Lane, W in a straight line to the boundary stone on Burnley Road, continuing in a straight line to and N along the A56(T) by-pass to the roundabout connecting the A56(T), the A680 and the B6527, N by a straight lin e  crossing Haslingdon Road A681 to the junction of Kirkhill Road and Haslingden Old Road  at Height End, N by Laund Lane to Cribden End Lane and N by the track to Cribden Side and N by the King’s Highway to and along the Rossendale - Hyndburn District Boundary to Higher Moor where the boundaries of Hyndburn, Rossendale and Burnley Districts meet.

internalBoundaries.name: Former boundary between St James the Lees and St Joseph with St Peter
internalBoundaries.description: S in a straight line to Edge Lane, Dobbin Lane and Peel Street crossing Bacup, Road A681 and S from the junction with Hill End Lane to Cowpe Lowe to meet the end of Sand Beds Lane.
